summary: This standards-track memo defines the IPSECKEY resource record, a DNS record type for storing public keys used by IPsec. The record can also say which gateway should be contacted when an IPsec tunnel is set up. It replaces the older approach of keeping such keys in KEY records.

eli5.summary: The phone book of the Internet, DNS, can also hold a lock that others use to send you secret messages. This record stores that lock and tells people where to knock.
